content.text:
- "traefik.http.routers.frontend.entrypoints=${TRAEFIK_ENTRYPOINT:-websecure}"
      - "traefik.http.services.frontend.loadbalancer.server.port=80"

  migrations:
    profiles: ["app"]
    build:
      context: ./backend/
      args:
        - APP_VERSION=${APP_VERSION:-dev}
        - APP_REVISION=${APP_GIT_COMMIT:-unknown}
        - GE_GIT_COMMIT=${APP_GIT_COMMIT:-unknown}
        - GE_GIT_BRANCH=${APP_GIT_BRANCH:-unknown}
        - GE_BUILD_TIME=${APP_BUILD_TIME:-unknown}
    entrypoint: ["./migrate"]
    command: ["reset", "--with-seed"]
    depends_on:
      db:
        condition: service_healthy
      keycloak-init-db:
        condition: service_completed_successfully
    environment:
      - APP_ENVIRONMENT=local
      - APP_DATABASE__HOST=db
      - APP_DATABASE__PORT=5432
      - APP_DATABASE__DATABASE_NAME=${POSTGRES_DB:-postgres}
      - APP_DATABASE__USERNAME=${POSTGRES_USER:-postgres}
      - APP_DATABASE__PASSWORD=${POSTGRES_PASSWORD:-postgres}

  demo-plugin:
    # Behind a profile so `just infra-up` does not build it; start it with
    # `just plugin-demo-up` when the plugin integration is being tested.
    profiles: ["plugins"]
    build:
      context: ./frontend
      dockerfile: demo-plugin/Dockerfile
    environment:
      # Points at the backend `just run-dev` runs on the host. Set it to
      # http://backend:3000/api to run against the `app` profile instead.
      - GE_API_BASE_URL=${GE_API_BASE_URL:-http://host.docker.internal:3030/api}
    extra_hosts:
      - "host.docker.internal:host-gateway"
    # A published localhost port, not a traefik host: an external plugin
    # frontend must be https unless its host is exactly `localhost`.
    ports:
      - "127.0.0.1:5175:80"
    healthcheck:
      test:
        [
          "CMD",
          "wget",
          "--quiet",
          "--tries=1",
          "--spider",
          "http://localhost/api/session",
        ]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 5s
      start_period: 5s
      retries: 3

volumes:
  db_data:
381 /workspace/compose.yaml
